A_business_and_data.evidence: Frozen inputs, per-fold mature gate-arrival labels, strict availability clocks, latest revision withdrawal, tenant and opportunity keys. Fractional-second training target declared; shared evaluation definition deferred to M3b.3.

B_analysis_and_models.evidence: Trip-balanced fitting, fixed parameter families, strict fold/transformer binding, retained predictions and raw quantiles. No validation accuracy, selection, calibration or final-test scoring.

C_engineering_and_delivery.evidence: 247 unit tests, fresh isolated dependency install/pip check, independent arithmetic reconciliation, zero-difference inference and training replay, atomic publication and drift rejection. macOS and later CI/production integration pending.

D_business_applicability.evidence: Every dispatch prediction opportunity retained; invalid estimates cannot become unflagged positive promises. Fallback support and unavailable outcomes explicit. Notification capacity, response cost and operator adoption remain later work.

E_external_validity.evidence: Synthetic near-linear motion is not real-road validation. No commercial benefit, live performance or deployment claim.
